{{Top|leg}}
'''Information-collating droids''' were a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. [[TelBrinTel Corporation]] expanded their droid offerings during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by adding [[Paramedic droid|paramedic]] and information-collating droids to their product line.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
